title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Peer Proof Harness Verification
verification_method: Focused local-loopback peer proof script, local cross-process sample peer proof script, local external aioquic peer proof script, aggregate HTTP/3 WebSocket xUnit test, sample client/server executable proof, stdout/stderr capture, Docker peer image identity capture, qlog/key-log capture, artifact hashing, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene.
scope: This verification covers local-loopback, local cross-process, and local external aioquic peer proof for the already trace-owned RFC 9220 WebSocket-over-HTTP/3 tunnel surface: Extended CONNECT setup, accepted metadata, server ping/client pong helper behavior, client ping/server pong behavior, fragmented or ordinary text exchange, buffered binary exchange, client close, and server close echo.
preconditions: Platform QUIC client and listener support are available locally.
The existing RFC 9220 unit and loopback requirement homes remain the source of detailed behavior coverage.
OpenSSL is available when generating cross-process throwaway TLS materials.
Docker is available locally when running the aioquic external-peer proof.
expected_result: The local-loopback proof script, cross-process proof script, external aioquic proof script, and aggregate test pass; the local-loopback manifest records one passed test; the cross-process manifest records a passed sample-client/sample-server exchange; the external aioquic manifest records a passed aioquic-client/Incursa-server exchange with peer image identity, qlog, TLS key log, stdout/stderr, and artifact hashes; SpecTrace validation accepts the artifacts; and diff hygiene is clean.
status_summary: The 2026-06-19 local-loopback peer proof passed one aggregate RFC 9220 WebSocket-over-HTTP/3 test. It covers Extended CONNECT setup, accepted metadata, server ping/client pong behavior, fragmented client text reassembly with an interleaved ping control frame and echoed pong, buffered 6000-byte binary exchange, client close, and server close echo. Local-loopback TRX SHA256: 59727BEA72F6BCC973A0EE56E2112845BD4E7D0AA5FA2406D012D8CF08F2EC98. The 2026-06-19 local cross-process proof passed with the sample server process and sample client process communicating over HTTP/3 loopback. It covers Extended CONNECT setup, accepted metadata, server ping/client pong behavior, client ping/server pong echo, text echo, 6000-byte binary echo, client close, and server close echo. The 2026-06-19 local external aioquic proof passed with an aioquic 1.3.0 HTTP/3 client container opening an RFC 9220 Extended CONNECT tunnel to the Incursa sample server process. It covers accepted response metadata, server ping/aioquic pong, aioquic ping/server pong, text echo, 6000-byte binary echo, aioquic close, and server close echo. aioquic image ID: sha256:b022b70e9f351326bf2951c5a56c5a00808b9f0b226a363d8b1b27014352d975.
